title: Short: Why you should never bet against the internet (GameStop)

lines.text: Why you should never bet against the internet.
In January twenty twenty-one, hedge funds bet that GameStop's stock would crash.
They had shorted about a hundred forty percent of its tradable shares.
Then a Reddit forum with millions of members started buying.
The stock exploded from seventeen dollars to over four hundred eighty.
Short sellers lost billions. One hedge fund needed a two point seven five billion dollar rescue.
